items.title: James "Sugarboy" Crawford Interview, 1975-04-29
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...did you, uh, try to play like Professor Long here? [INTERVIEWEE] I never tried to play like anybody.

ctx.x: He was still playing the guitar. He was still playing the guitar as long as he could. He couldn't get out, so we had to go get him.
Did you, uh, piano, you played piano, did you, did you, uh, listen to anybody? Like, did, did you, uh, try to play like Professor Long here?
I never tried to play like anybody. I just, I just liked to play piano, and I just played. I never really, uh, idolized anybody, really.
